blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Synthetic populations, large sets of simulated people, are increasingly used in place of real people to pretest surveys, simulate users and communities, and evaluate AI systems. Each simulated person is defined by a persona, a written profile of fixed traits, demographics, and attitudes that a language model is instructed to act out. Every such system assumes that a person's identity is a stable attribute that behaves the same way in every situation the simulation presents. We show that this assumption is not a harmless simplification. Three decades of personality research find the opposite. How a given person behaves varies more across contexts than people vary from one another. Drawing on identity economics, which describes how different situations activate different identities and norms within the same person, we separate behavior into three parts, which are stable traits, the identity a context calls up, and the situation itself. We then prove, under two stated assumptions, that any simulation built on fixed personas, no matter how detailed the personas or how large the underlying model, cannot reproduce the part of a population's behavior that is specific to it and its circumstances. We propose a new evaluation criterion based on this result and a person-in-context design that can meet it in principle. We test one version on a naturalistic Reddit personality corpus and on a published clinical-trial recruitment survey of a community with documented distrust of medical institutions. The design does produce context-dependent behavior when tested directly, but in neither setting does it fully match the real population, and we show where it falls short. The consequence for practice is a risk that synthetic-population evaluations misrepresent the groups whose behavior is most shaped by context, a distortion that richer personas cannot correct.
blocks.zh: 合成人群,大型的模拟人群,被越来越多地用于代替真人进行预测试调查,模拟用户和社区,并评价AI系统. 每个模拟人由一个人物a,一个固定特征的书面剖面,人口学,以及语言模型指示采取行动的态度来定义. 每一个这样的系统都假设一个人的身份是稳定的属性,在模拟呈现的每一个情况中行为都一样. 我们表明,这种假设并非是无害的简化。 三十年的人格研究发现与此相反. 一个人的行为方式因背景而异,而人则因人而异。 借鉴身份经济学,描述不同情况如何激活同一人内部的不同身份和规范,我们把行为分为三个部分,这三个部分是稳定的特征,一个上下文唤起的身份,以及情况本身. 然后,我们根据两个陈述的假设证明,任何建立在固定人身上的模拟,无论人有多详细,或基本模型有多大,都不能复制人口行为中与它及其具体情况具体相关的部分。 我们根据这一结果提出了一个新的评价标准,并提出了可以原则上满足其要求的实际设计。 我们测试一个关于自然主义的Reddit人格保护书的版本,并测试对一个对医疗机构有文件记载的不信任的社区进行公开的临床审判性招聘调查。 设计在直接测试时确实会产生上下文依赖的行为,但在两个设定中都没有完全匹配真实的人群,我们显示其不足之处. 做法的后果是,合成人口评价有可能歪曲其行为最受背景影响的群体,这种扭曲是较富人无法纠正的。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Companies and researchers now pretest surveys, products, and messages on AI-simulated populations before asking real customers or citizens, and some propose using the simulations instead of asking at all ( Argyle et al., 2023 ; Bisbee et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Some systems already hold billions of simulated people ( Li et al., 2026b ) , built in part from hundreds of hours of real interviews ( Park et al., 2024 ) . These systems share one design choice. Each simulated person is a persona , a written profile, vector, or interview transcript that is prepared before the simulation runs. Some systems retrieve different parts of it for different questions, but what is stored about the person never changes. A persona therefore fixes the person’s identity too, which we take from Akerlof and Kranton ( Akerlof and Kranton, 2000 ) to mean a person’s sense of self as a member of a social category, along with the norms for how members of that category act. A real person holds several identities, such as employee, parent, or friend, and which one is active depends on the situation, so the same person may be formal and careful in a meeting with colleagues and relaxed and joking at dinner with friends (§ 3.1 ). Current persona designs cannot represent this shift. Any change in behavior across situations is the large language model (LLM) improvising, and the persona itself never changes (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 公司和研究人员现在先对人工智能模拟人群的调查、产品和信息进行预先测试,然后再询问真正的客户或公民,有些公司和研究人员提议使用模拟,而不是完全询问(Argyle等人,2023年;Bisbee等人,2024年;Li等人,2026年b) 。 一些系统已经拥有数十亿的模拟人(Li等人,2026年b),部分建于数百小时的真实访谈(Park等人,2024年). 这些系统有一个设计选择。 每个模拟人都是在模拟运行前准备的人物a、书面简介、矢量或访谈记录。 有些系统为了不同的问题而检索到其中的不同部分,但存储的关于人物的内容却从未改变. 因此,一个人也可以确定一个人的身份,我们从Akerlof和Kranton(Akerlof和Kranton,2000年)中将其理解为一个人作为社会类别成员的自我意识,以及该类别成员的行为规范。 真实的人拥有多个身份,如雇员,父母,或朋友,而谁是活跃的则取决于情况,因此,在与同事的会面中,同一人可能是正式的,谨慎的,在与朋友的晚餐中放松和开玩笑(第3.1节). 当前人物设计不能代表这种转变. 各种情况行为的任何变化都是大语言模型(LLM)即兴化,人物本身也从未改变(图1).

blocks.en: In personality psychology, most of the variation in trait-related behavior is within persons rather than between them ( Fleeson and Gallagher, 2009 ; Fleeson, 2001 ) . Identity economics ( Akerlof and Kranton, 2000 ; Akerlof and Kranton, 2010 ) offers an account of this variation. A person belongs to several social categories, each category carries norms for how its members act, and the situation determines which category is active and therefore which norms the person follows (§ 2.2 ). Recent work has started to notice the symptoms. Studies report that fixed personas collapse toward a typical default ( Ozkan, 2026 ) and compress variation within demographic groups ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , while other work lets the personality of a single dialogue agent shift as a conversation unfolds ( Pielage et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) . To our knowledge, none of this work says what a simulated population must reproduce to behave like a real one, and none represents identity as a state that context activates (§ 2 ). Existing validation does not fill that gap either. Persona adherence ( Li et al., 2026b ) asks whether a simulated person acts as its profile says. Test-retest consistency and prediction of held-out survey answers ( Park et al., 2024 ) are internal-validity checks that ask whether a simulation reproduces what a person answered on the same kind of survey. Subgroup coverage ( Batzner et al., 2025 ) asks whether the right kinds of people are included. None of these asks the external-validity question of whether simulated people behave like real people once the situation changes. We call a test of that question a behavioral-fidelity evaluation (do simulated people respond to a new situation the way real people do?).
blocks.zh: 在人格心理学中,特征相关行为的大部分变化发生在人内部而不是他们之间(Fleeson和Gallagher,2009年;Fleeson,2001年)。 身份经济学(Akerlof和Kranton,2000年;Akerlof和Kranton,2010年)对这一变化作了说明。 一个人属于几个社会类别,每个类别都有其成员如何行动的规范,情况决定了哪个类别是活跃的,因此,他遵循了哪些规范(第2.2节)。 最近的工作已经开始注意到这些症状。 研究报告指出,固定的人倒向了典型的默认(Ozkan, 2026年),并压缩了人口组内的变异(Wang等人, 2026年),而其他工作则让单一对话代理人的个性随着对话的展开而转变(Pielage等人, 2026年;Wei等人, 2026年)。 据我们所知,这些作品中没有一个说模拟人口必须复制什么才能表现得像一个真实的人,没有一个代表身份的状态是环境激活的(§2). 现有的验证也无法填补这一空白。 Persona 坚持(Li等人,2026年b)询问一个模拟人是否按照它的特征行事. 测试-再测试一致性和对被搁置调查答案的预测(Park等人,2024年)是内效检查,询问模拟是否复制了一个人在同类调查中回答的问题. 分组报道(Batzner等人,2025年)询问是否包括了合适的人群。 这些都没有人提出外部有效性问题,即一旦情况发生变化,模拟人的行为是否与真实人一样. 我们把测试这个问题称为行为-忠诚评价(模拟人是否以真实人的方式回应新情况?).

blocks.en: The gap has consequences. Suppose a city emergency office pretests the wording of a flood evacuation alert on simulated residents, because a live test is impossible. A real resident may ignore a text from the city as one more automated message, yet leave at once when a neighbor knocks on the door or a relative calls. A persona that says “distrusts authorities” predicts that no version of the alert works, and a persona that leaves distrust out predicts that every version works. Either way, the office chooses its wording and its messenger on the model’s guess, and the residents who most need to leave may stay. The error matters more when the simulated people stand in for patients or citizens and the decision reaches a real community (§ 6.3 ).
blocks.zh: 差距会产生后果。 假设一个城市应急办公室预先测试了模拟居民的洪水疏散警报的措辞,因为现场测试是不可能的. 真正的居民可能会忽略来自城市的短信作为另一个自动消息,然而当邻居敲门或亲属打电话时,立刻离开. 一个说“不信任当局”的人预测警报没有任何版本有效,一个不不信任的人预测每个版本都有效。 无论哪种方式,办公室都会根据模型的猜测来选择其措辞和信使,最需要离开的居民可以留下来. 当模拟人站在病人或公民面前,而决定到达一个真正的社区时,错误更为重要(第6.3节)。

blocks.en: We make three contributions.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献。

blocks.en: (1) Can richer personas fix this? No, and we give a formal proof. Any simulation built on a fixed persona cannot reproduce what is specific to a person beyond their group’s typical response, however detailed the persona and however large the model. The proof relies on two stated assumptions, and we test how it degrades when they only roughly hold (§ 4.2 , Appendix B ). (2) How would we know? A new evaluation criterion. Latent State-Trait (LST) fingerprint recovery has three parts. It asks how much of the variation in behavior is between people, how much comes from particular people in particular situations, and whether a simulation tracks each person’s specific response. The proof shows that, in principle, fixed personas cannot meet the third check (§ 4 ). (3) What would work? A person-in-context design and two tests of it. We build a person-in-context approach, in which a situation selects an identity state that the language model then acts out, and we test it against fixed personas on two real datasets. Fixed personas make each person behave almost the same in every situation, far more than real people do, and our design comes closer on all five personality traits we tested. On a published clinical-trial recruitment study, our design reproduces the overall effect of trust on how respondents rate the ads, and its behavior changes as expected when the identity state is switched. It does not reproduce the study’s central finding that which ad theme works best depends on how much a person trusts the healthcare system, and we explain why in § 5 . Person-specific signal is near zero for every system we test, so that test cannot yet separate them.
blocks.zh: (1) 富人能解决这个问题吗? 不,我们给出一个正式的证据。 任何建立在固定人身上的模拟都无法复制个人特有的超出其群体典型反应范围的东西,无论该模型是否详细和大小。 证据依赖于两个陈述的假设,我们检验这些假设仅仅大致维持时如何降解(第4.2节,附录B)。 (2)我们怎么知道? 新的评价标准。 后期国家-塔利班(LST)指纹的恢复有三个部分。 它询问人们之间的行为差异有多大, 在特定情况下来自特定人群的差别有多大, 证据表明,原则上,固定人无法满足第三次检查(第4节)。 (3) 哪些工作会奏效? 人物内涵设计及两次测试. 我们构建了一种结合人的方法,在一个情况中,选择一个身份状态,即语言模型会发挥作用,然后在两个真正的数据集上测试固定人。 固定的人让每个人在每一种情况下的行为都几乎一样,远比真实的人要多,我们的设计更接近我们测试过的所有五个个性特征. 在一项公布的临床实验性招聘研究中,我们的设计复制了信任对应答者如何评分广告的整体影响,以及其行为在身份状态切换时的预期变化. 我们解释为什么在第5节。 对于我们测试的每个系统来说,针对具体人物的信号接近零,因此测试尚不能将它们分开.

Closing that gap is an open problem.
blocks.zh: 原则上,在文本中人物设计可以代表人物对上下文的特异性反应,固定人物可以证明不能. 在我们的测试中,我们构建的实施复制了真实数据的一些特征,如信任的效果,但还没有发现最佳广告主题取决于信任. 缩小这一差距是一个公开的问题。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Our contribution connects three bodies of work that have not been brought together, namely synthetic populations for AI evaluation, behavioral science on how people act in context, and the critique of representational harm in generative systems.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献将尚未汇集的三组工作联系起来,即用于人工智能评估的合成人口、关于人们如何在背景下行事的行为科学以及对基因系统中代表性伤害的批评。

blocks.en: 2.1. Synthetic populations for AI evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1. 人工智能评估合成人群

blocks.en: Simulated people are used for LLM-based evaluation in many ways, for example to pretest survey questions, to simulate public opinion, and to stress-test chat systems with simulated users. These systems fall into three families, which differ in how they represent identity.
blocks.zh: 模拟人在许多方面用于基于LLM的评价,例如用于预先测试调查问题,模拟舆论,以及使用模拟用户的压力测试聊天系统. 这些系统分为三个家庭,它们代表身份的方式各不相同。

blocks.en: The fixed-persona family dominates current systems. A persona, whether a categorical vector, a written profile, or an interview transcript, is set up in advance and does not change with the situation. MatrAIx ( Li et al., 2026b ) is the current large-scale example, with 8.3 billion persona records, a 1,290-dimension schema, and a 91.5% persona-adherence rate. Park et al. ( Park et al., 2024 ) use two-hour interview transcripts as personas for 1,052 people, and report that, on held-out General Social Survey items, interview-based agents reach 83% of participants’ own test-retest consistency. Argyle et al. ( Argyle et al., 2023 ) condition on demographics with lighter personas. Bisbee et al. ( Bisbee et al., 2024 ) find that such synthetic survey responses have much less variance than real respondents, and that many regression coefficients differ significantly from human data. In this family, context stays outside the persona, and the language model alone supplies any adaptation.
blocks.zh: 固定人种家族主导当前系统. 人物,无论是绝对矢量,书面简介,还是采访笔录,都是事先设置的,不会随情况变化. Matrax(Li等人,2026年b)是目前大规模的例子,有83亿人a记录,1,290-dimension schema,以及91.5%的人a-坚持率. 朴正熙等编. (Park et al., 2024)使用2小时的访谈记录片作为1,052人的个人记录片,并报告说,在被搁置的《一般社会调查》项目上,基于访谈的代理人达到83%的参与者自己的测试-测试一致性。 Argyle等人著. (Argyle等人,2023年) 人口结构条件较轻。 Bisbee 等 (英语). (Bisbee等人,2024年)发现此类合成调查回复与真实回复者差异小得多,许多回归系数与人类数据差异很大. 在这个家庭中,上下文留在人之外a,仅语言模型就提供任何适应.

blocks.en: The memory-evolving family adds accumulated experience to a fixed persona. Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) , SOTOPIA ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , Concordia ( Vezhnevets et al., 2023 ) , OASIS ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , and AgentSociety ( Piao et al., 2025 ) give agents a memory stream with reflection or planning. Variation then follows what has happened to the agent, closer to a diary than to identities that the present situation brings out.
blocks.zh: 记忆传承家庭将积累的经验加进固定人物a. 遗传剂(Park等人,2023年),SOTOPIA(Zhou等人,2024年),康科迪亚 (Vezhnevets等人,2023年),OASIS(Yang等人,2024年),Agent Society(Piao等人,2025年)给特工们一个带有反思或规划的记忆流. 然后随从特工的遭遇而变化,更接近日记,而不是当前情况所呈现的身份.

blocks.en: The person-in-context family treats identity as a state that context activates. It has theoretical roots in self-categorization theory and multiple-self-aspects frameworks ( McConnell, 2011 ) , and related computational work exists for single dialogue agents. Pielage et al. ( Pielage et al., 2026 ) model an assistant’s personality as latent states in a state machine whose transitions follow the conversation. Wei et al. ( Wei et al., 2026 ) steer persona-related neurons in a model according to the situation. Lee et al. ( Lee et al., 2025 ) build a persona from social identity, personal identity, and life context. These works adapt one agent within an interaction or enrich a single persona. We found none that represents a population of people with context-activated identities and tests it against real within-person variation. That is the gap we address.
blocks.zh: 内容内人家族将身份视为上下文激活的状态. 它在自我分类理论和多个自我视角框架(McConnell,2011年)中有着理论根源,相关的计算工作也存在于单一对话代理. Pielage等人著. (Pielage et al., 2026)将助理的个性作为潜伏状态, 魏等编. (Wei等人,2026年)根据情况在模型中引导与人有关的神经元. 李等编. (Lee et al.,2025)从社会身份、个人身份和生活背景来构建人物。 这些作品在互动中适应了一种物剂或者丰富了单一人. 我们发现没有任何人代表着具有内幕激活身份的人口,并测试他们是否真实存在人际差异。 这就是我们处理的差距。

blocks.en: Concurrent critiques. Several recent studies conclude from different angles that fixed personas are the wrong unit for population simulation. They report collapse toward a typical default in some scenarios ( Ozkan, 2026 ) , declining observer-rated persona expression over long conversations ( Gonnermann-Müller et al., 2026 ) , subgroup-specific distortions from multi-attribute personas ( Taday Morocho et al., 2026 ) , inconsistent subgroup alignment from sociodemographic prompting ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , and compressed variation within demographic groups, for which a longitudinal memory remedy is proposed ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . None derives an evaluation criterion from within-person variance or proposes a context-activated identity design.

blocks.en: 2.2. Behavioral science on person-in-context
blocks.zh: 2.2. 人文行为科学

blocks.en: In personality research, most of the variation in trait-related behavior is within persons, from one moment to the next ( Fleeson and Gallagher, 2009 ) . This helped resolve the person-situation debate of the 1990s ( Fleeson, 2001 ; Fleeson and Jayawickreme, 2015 ) . Latent State-Trait (LST) theory ( Steyer et al., 1992 ; Steyer et al., 2015 ) splits behavior into trait, state, and error, and variance ratios akin to intraclass correlations give each part’s share. Whole Trait Theory, which came later, describes a trait as a distribution of states around a stable level ( Fleeson, 2001 ; Fleeson and Jayawickreme, 2015 ) . Inspired by both, we write behavior as Y = τ + s ⁡ ( X ) + ε Y=\tau+s(X)+\varepsilon , a stable level plus a response to the situation plus noise. In § 3.1 we extend s ⁡ ( X ) s(X) with a person-specific, context-activated term I p , c , t I_{p,c,t} .
blocks.zh: 在人格研究中,特征相关行为的大部分变化发生在人内部,从一个时刻到另一个时刻(Fleeson and Gallagher,2009年). 这有助于解决1990年代的人与情况的辩论(Fleeson,2001年;Fleeson和Jayawickreme,2015年)。 Latent State-Trait(LST)理论(Steyer等人,1992年;Steyer等人,2015年)将行为分为特征、状态和错误,与阶级内部相关关系相似的差异比率为每一部分。 后来出现的"全轨论"(All Trait Theory)将特征描述为稳定水平周围的状态分布(Fleeson,2001;Fleeson and Jayawickreme,2015). 在两者的启发下,我们将行为写成Y = τ + s ⁡ (X) + ε Y=\tau+s(X) +\varepsilon,一个稳定的关卡加上对情况的反应加上噪音. 在§3.1中,我们扩展 s ⁡(X) s(X) ,以特定人物,上下文激活的术语 I p, c, t I_{p, c, t}.

In a Reddit corpus, it finds that most variance is within persons, about 72 to 74% across the 26 trait dimensions it measures, without removing measurement noise, in line with the psychological literature. It also finds that language models prompted with personas do not track context-driven change, which it calls state-blind . Han et al. blocks.en: Identity as a building block. Akerlof and Kranton ( Akerlof and Kranton, 2000 ; Akerlof and Kranton, 2010 ) treat identity as a variable in a person’s decisions, with actions judged against the norms of the identity that is active. Trait Activation Theory ( Tett and Guterman, 2000 ) reaches a compatible view, that situations activate traits through cues, and self-categorization theory ( Turner et al., 1987 ) and the multiple-self-aspects framework ( McConnell, 2011 ) agree. We found no synthetic-population system or evaluation built on any of them.

blocks.en: 2.3. Representational harm in generative systems
blocks.zh: 2.3. 基因系统的代表性损害

blocks.en: Representational harm connects this work to questions of fairness and accountability. A synthetic population that flattens a group misrepresents that group, and decisions made from it reach real communities. Bender et al. ( Bender et al., 2021 ) warn that scaling language models without attention to whose language is represented risks amplifying dominant viewpoints. Blodgett et al. ( Blodgett et al., 2020 ) argue that work on “bias” often does not say which harms to which communities it addresses. Our criterion responds to this by naming one specific distortion, flattening of context-dependent behavior, and measuring it. Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2025 ) show that replacing human participants with LLMs can misportray and flatten identity groups. Two findings concern persona-based systems directly. Xiao et al. ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) find that models with the highest per-persona fidelity produce the most polarized populations, so persona adherence and population fidelity can pull apart. Batzner et al. ( Batzner et al., 2025 ) find that only 35% of 63 persona-based LLM studies report anything about representativeness. That is a separate problem, since a representative, transparently sampled set of personas is still fixed and would still fail our criterion. These critiques name the outcome but not its cause. We locate the flattening in one design choice, identity as a fixed attribute of the persona, which cannot match the real structure of within-person variation. Richer personas do not remove it.

(Blodgett等人,2020年)认为,关于“偏见”的工作往往没有说明它对哪个社区造成的伤害。 我们的标准通过命名一种特定的扭曲, 平整依赖上下文的行为, 并测量它来回应这一点。 王等编. (Wang等人,2025年)显示,用LLMS取代人类参与者可以错画和扁平身份群体. 两项调查结果直接涉及基于个人的系统。 萧等. (Xiao等人,2026年)发现,人性忠诚度最高的模型产生最两极化的人口,因此人性守信度和人口忠诚度可以拉开. Batzner等 (英语). (Batzner等人,2025年)发现,在63个基于人物的LLM研究中,只有35%报告任何关于代表性的内容. 这是一个单独的问题,因为代表性的、透明地抽样的一组人仍然是固定的,仍然不符合我们的标准。 这些批评点出了结果而不是其原因。 我们把扁平定位在一个设计选择中,身份作为人物的固定属性a,这不能与人体内变异的实际结构相匹配. 有钱人不会去除它。

blocks.en: 2.4. Gap

Behavioral science models how people act in context, and identity economics accounts for the mechanism. Neither has been built into a synthetic-population system and tested there against real within-person variation, and current validation does not check for it. We add what the critique literature lacks (§ 2.1 , § 2.3 ), namely an explanation of why these failures occur, a new evaluation criterion derived from it (§ 4 ), and a formal result (§ 4.2 ) that, under two stated assumptions, the failure comes from the design, whatever the scale or prompting.

blocks.en: A simulation system stores a representation of each person, builds a prompt for each situation, and calls a language model. The inputs that the model’s generation call receives are the system’s interface . A single-call system produces each response with one such call. A system with subroutines runs extra steps first, such as a rule or a second language-model call that scores which identity a situation brings out, and passes the result into the interface. The interface is then the full list of inputs to the generation call, whether they come from storage or from a subroutine. blocks.en: 3.3. A Limit Built Into the Fixed-Persona Design
blocks.zh: 3.3. 固定个人设计中的限制

blocks.en: We do not claim that fixed-persona and memory-evolving systems fail at what they were built for. Sampling varied profiles for product testing ( Li et al., 2026b ) , simulating social dynamics in a sandbox ( Park et al., 2023 ) , and predicting individual attitudes ( Park et al., 2024 ) are legitimate goals, judged fairly by their own criteria. Our claim is narrower. These systems are now proposed for behavioral simulation , which means reproducing how a population responds across contexts. For that goal they meet a target their design does not represent.
blocks.zh: 我们并不声称固定人称和记忆进化系统会因为建造这些系统而失败。 采样各种产品测试简介(Li等人,2026年b),模拟沙盒中的社会动态(Park等人,2023年),以及预测个人态度(Park等人,2024年)是合法的目标,根据自己的标准判断是公平的. 我们的说法比较狭隘。 这些系统现在被提议用于行为模拟,这意味着再现一个人口在各种背景中的反应方式. 为此,它们达到了它们的设计并不代表的目标。

blocks.en: In a fixed-persona system the persona does not change with context, so no input says which identity the situation has brought out for this person. The model must infer one from the persona and the situation, or a subroutine supplies one that reads only those two inputs. Either way the output is a function of ( π p , X c , t ) (\pi_{p},X_{c,t}) alone (Proposition 1, § 4.2 ), so person-context interaction is limited by the variance that the model’s own inference adds ( Han et al., 2026 ; Harry et al., 2026 ) . This holds for every fixed-persona system, whatever the persona format or the model. A richer persona adds between-person variance and does not create person-context interaction. A similar argument applies to memory-evolving systems, whose memory is a within-person state but is not indexed by identity options the person can activate. Their variation follows the sequence of past events, with no role for the norms of the present situation.

blocks.en: The person-in-context family can represent person-specific response to context by construction. Whether a given implementation reproduces real within-person variance is an empirical question, which the criterion in § 4 answers. That the family is capable of it is a property of the design, whatever the implementation. The fixed-persona failures in § 5.2 and § 5.3 follow from this. The memory-evolving family is open to a similar argument, but neither dataset tests it, because both compare only fixed-persona arms (A and B) with the person-in-context arm (C). Arm C’s results concern one implementation (our specification of the identity states and how they are activated). They do not change what the design itself can represent (§ 6.1 ).

blocks.en: 4. Evaluation Criterion: LST Fingerprint Recovery
blocks.zh: 4. 评价标准: LST 指纹回收

blocks.en: § 3 shows that only the person-in-context family can represent I p , c , t I_{p,c,t} as person-specific. A new criterion turns that difference into something measurable, which we call Latent State-Trait (LST) fingerprint recovery . A fingerprint is a pattern specific enough to identify who it belongs to. A population’s LST fingerprint is how stable people are relative to one another, and how much and in what way each person varies across situations. The criterion, built on the LST variance decomposition (§ 3.1 ) ( Steyer et al., 1992 ; Eid and Diener, 2004 ) , checks whether a synthetic population reproduces the real fingerprint as well as the average response levels.

LST fingerprint recovery compares a synthetic system 𝒜 \mathcal{A} with a real population on three components.

blocks.en: (1) Between-person share (ICC). The intraclass correlation (ICC, bias-corrected) is the fraction of all variation in behavior that comes from stable differences between people. The rest is one person varying across situations, plus noise. A system that inflates this share treats identity as more fixed than real behavior supports. (2) Person-context interaction variance ( Var P × C \mathrm{Var}_{P\times C} ). This is the variance left after removing person and context main effects. It comes from particular people in particular contexts (§ 3.1 ). A system can match the real ICC and still show almost no interaction, because everyone reacts to context in the same way. ICC alone cannot tell these cases apart. (3) Person-specific signal (person-specific residual correlation). This is the component our proof addresses. A fixed persona cannot reach it by design, and a person-in-context system can in principle. Two people of the same general type, for example both skeptical of institutions, still react differently to a given situation. The shared, predictable part is state-typical . The leftover part is person-specific , the signature a system must capture if it claims to simulate that person, beyond their type. The reason is that a system could match the full human residual R p , c human R^{\text{human}}_{p,c} by copying state-typical patterns that a stated persona often reveals, without representing anything specific to the person.

Proposition 1 shows that a fixed-persona output depends on the persona, the context, and noise only, for any language model and any persona, which rules out the common hope that richer personas or larger models will close the gap. The assumptions are not part of the definition, and they can fail, for example when a persona is built from a person’s own behavior across contexts. The corollary bounds the effect when they hold only approximately. The prediction can also be tested. If personas leaked person-specific information, Arm A’s correlation with the real residual would be large, and in § 5.2 it is small (0.026).
blocks.zh: 证据补充了定义以外的内容. 如果只重述一个人a没有关于QQ p, c\Delta_{p,c}的信息,结果将是空的. 上面写得更多 提议1显示,固定人物输出只取决于任何语言模型和任何人物的人物,上下文和噪声,这就排除了富人或较大模型能缩小差距的共同希望. 假设不是定义的一部分,它们可能失败,例如,一个人从个人行为中构建出来时,情况会不同。 其必然结果在它们只保持大约时就限制了效果。 预测也可以测试. 如果某人泄露了具体个人的信息,Arm A与真正残留物的关联性将很大,在第5.2节中,该关联度很小(0.026)。

blocks.en: What this establishes. No fixed-persona system that meets the two assumptions can reach the third component beyond a small margin set by the corollary, whatever the model scale or data. Richer prompts or larger models can improve the first two components without touching this limit.
blocks.zh: 这证明什么? 任何符合两个假设的固定人称系统,无论模型尺度或数据如何,都无法超越必然结果设定的微小比值,达到第三个组件. 更丰富的提示或更大的模型可以改进前两个组件而不触及这个极限.

blocks.en: 4.3. Scope: What the Criterion Does Not Establish
blocks.zh: 4.3. 范围: 标准没有规定

blocks.en: The criterion has two limits. First, the proof concerns the third component only, so it does not say that fixed personas must show inflated ICC or near-zero interaction variance. Those are diagnostics that we report for every system in § 5.2 . A fixed-persona system could show real-scale ICC or substantial interaction variance and still fail the third component. Second, the result depends on the two assumptions, or their approximate version. They are claims about how personas are built and how contexts are assigned, and neither follows from context-invariance alone. A persona built from a demographic profile and a stated identity state meets the Key Assumption directly, because Δ p , c \Delta_{p,c} is by construction what such instruments cannot see. A persona built by hand-picking a person’s own responses across contexts would break it, because the persona would then contain the signal that Proposition 2 assumes it lacks.
blocks.zh: 标准有两个限度。 第一,证明只涉及第三个部分,因此它不说固定人物必须显示充气的ICC或接近零的相互作用差异. 这是我们在第5.2节中报告每个系统的诊断。 固定人称系统可以显示实际规模的ICC或实质性的相互作用差异,但仍会失败第三个组件. 第二,结果取决于两个假设,或其大致版本。 它们都是关于人是如何建立和如何分配背景的主张,而两者都不是仅从上下文的偏差得出的。 一个从人口概况和身份状态中建构的人直接与关键假设相遇,因为 Δ p, c\Delta_{p, c} 是通过构造这些工具无法看到的。 一个通过亲手挑选个人在各种情况下的反应而建立起来的人会打破它,因为人随后会包含一个信号,即提议2假设它缺乏这个信号。

blocks.en: Within this scope, the criterion gives person-in-context systems a target that fixed-persona systems cannot meet in principle, and gives any implementation of π I \pi_{I} a concrete three-part measure. § 5.2 and § 5.3 apply it to two datasets.
blocks.zh: 在这个范围内,该标准赋予了内人系统一个固定人系统原则上无法达到的目标,并且赋予了实施QQi i\pi\I}一个具体的三部分措施. §5.2和§5.3将其应用于两个数据集.

blocks.en: 5. Empirical Tests of the Criterion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 标准的经验测试

blocks.en: The proof in § 4.2 concerns what the fixed-persona design can represent. The experiments ask what the data show about fixed personas and what Arm C, a first, theory-motivated implementation of the alternative, achieves. In Chameleon, fixed personas (Arms A and B) place almost all variation between people, where real people show almost none, and in the motivational-themes study their agreement with the published pattern changes from 5 of 6 directions to 0 of 6 when one sentence is added. Arm C comes closest to the real variance structure on every Chameleon trait, it reproduces the effect of trust in the study, and its behavior follows the identity state it is given. Person-specific signal is near zero for every system we test, and Arm C does not yet reproduce the study’s interaction between ad theme and trust. We trace that gap to how the implementation represents trust, as a single level that does not change with context (§ 5.3.3 ), which is the flattening that § 6.3 names as a risk.
blocks.zh: 第4.2节中的证据涉及固定人名设计能够代表什么。 实验询问数据显示的固定人物 以及Arm C, 最初由理论驱动的替代品的实现, 取得了什么成就。 在Chameleon中,固定人物(Arms A和B)几乎将人与人之间的所有差异都放在一起,其中真实人物几乎没有表现出任何差异,在动机主题中研究他们对公布的图案的一致,从6个方向中的5个变为1个句子时的0个. Arm C最接近每个变色龙特质上的真实差异结构,它复制了对研究的信任效果,其行为遵循了赋予它的身份状态. 我们测试的每个系统都接近零, Arm C还没有复制研究的主题与信任之间的相互作用。 我们追踪到这一差距,即执行如何代表信任,作为一个没有因上下文而变化的单一层次(第5.3.3节),这就是将第6.3节的名称作为风险加以平整。

blocks.en: We chose the two datasets for what each can test. Chameleon records three posts from each of 1,667 people in different subreddits. Its repeated measures within each person, scored on many trait dimensions in a naturalistic corpus, make it the direct test of the between-person share and of person-specific signal. The motivational-themes study is not a dataset in the usual sense. It is a published survey experiment with one rating set per person, and we use its reported coefficients, sample demographics, and survey wording as a target. Because the real effect is known, we can say precisely where a simulation departs from it. Where the difference does not matter, we call both of them datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了两个数据集来测试每个数据集。 Chameleon记录了1,667人各有3个帖子在不同的下潜. 它在每个人内部的反复措施,在自然主义的多个特征方面得分,使它成为对人与人之间分享和针对具体个人的信号的直接考验。 动机主题研究不是通常意义上的数据集. 这是一个公开的调查实验, 每人有一个评级, 我们使用它报告的系数, 抽样人口, 和调查的措辞作为一个目标。 因为真正的效果是众所周知的,所以我们可以确切地说一个模拟偏离它的地方. 在区别无关紧要的地方,我们称两者为数据集.

blocks.en: 5.1. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1. 实验设置

blocks.en: Each dataset uses the same three arms, which differ only in what the language model is told about the person. Arm A (fixed persona) states a trait of the person once, such as “skeptical of institutions”, whatever the context. Arm B (fixed persona plus context) states the same trait and adds a neutral mention of the context, which tests whether naming the situation is enough when the person does not change. Arm C (person-in-context) states no fixed trait. It computes an identity state for each (person, context) pair, and the model acts out that state. Arms A and B are fixed-persona systems and neither keeps a record of past interactions, so neither dataset tests the memory-evolving family (§ 3.3 ). Appendix Table 15 shows what the model receives in each arm, and Appendix D gives the prompt for each arm.
blocks.zh: 每个数据集都使用相同的三条臂,这三条臂只在语言模型对人物的描述上有所不同. 武装A(固定人物a)说明一个人的特征,例如 " 对机构的怀疑 " ,不论背景如何。 Arm B(fixed persona place) 表示相同的特征,并添加了上下文的中性提法,该提法测试当人不改变时对情况命名是否足够. Arm C(隐形人物)表示没有固定特征. 它计算每个(人,上下文)对的身份状态,模型行为出该状态. 武器A和B是固定人称系统,既不保留过去的相互作用记录,因此两个数据集都没有测试内存进化家族(§3.3. 附录表15显示模型在每个臂部得到什么,附录D给出每个臂部的提示.

blocks.en: Arm C builds its identity states in two steps. First, we construct a set of candidate identity states for the population. For Chameleon we fit a Gaussian mixture model (GMM), a statistical method that finds groups of similar observations in data without predefined labels. In our case the observations are users’ trait scores, so the groups are users with similar trait profiles. For the motivational-themes study we write the states from clinical-recruitment literature, independently of the target study, and check them for circularity. Second, each person’s affinity for each state is matched against the context to pick one active state. Figures 3 and 4 in the appendix diagram the two pipelines. We fix each specification before testing it on real data. Any later revision is reported as a separate, documented version (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: Arm C分两步建立身份状态. 首先,我们为人口构建一套候选身份状态。 对于Chameleon,我们搭配了一个高斯混合模型(GMM),这个统计方法在数据中找到类似观测的组,没有预先定义的标签. 我们的观察是用户的特征分数, 对于动机主题研究,我们从临床招生文献中撰写各州,独立于目标研究,并检查它们是否循环. 第二,每个人对各州的亲和度与上下文相匹配,以选择一个活跃的州。 附录图3和图4列出了两条管道。 在测试真实数据之前,我们先确定每个规格。 以后的任何修订都作为单独的、有文件记载的版本(附录C)报告。

blocks.en: All arms use the same elicitation format, in which the model gives a short reasoning and then a rating (Appendix C.5 ), and the same model, Claude Haiku 4.5 at temperature 0.7. The model generates behavior in every arm. In Chameleon it also scores, in separate calls, how well each subreddit matches each identity state’s cues. In the motivational-themes study, the cue scores for the four ads are fixed numbers set in the code by the authors from the specification’s activation cues. We chose Claude Haiku 4.5 because its training data end in February 2025, before the motivational-themes study was published in March 2026, whereas later models may have been trained on its preprint and could recall the results.
blocks.zh: 所有武器都采用同样的诱导格式,模型给出了简短的推理,然后进行评级(附录C.5),同一种模型Claude Haiku 4.5温度0. 模型在每个臂部产生行为. 在Chameleon, 在单独的通话中, 在动机主题研究中,四个广告的提示分数是作者从规格的激活提示设定在代码中的固定数字. 我们选择Claude Haiku 4.5是因为其培训数据在2026年3月发表动机主题研究之前于2025年2月结束,而后来的模型可能已经接受了其预印本的培训,并且可以回顾结果.

blocks.en: The two datasets test different parts of the criterion. Chameleon tests the first component (between-person share) and the third, person-specific signal, directly. The motivational-themes study has one observation per person, so it cannot test the third component. We compare each arm with the published aggregate coefficients instead, which tests the second component, whether the system reproduces the real person-context interaction in aggregate.
blocks.zh: 这两个数据集测试了标准的不同部分. 变色龙直接测试第一个组件(在人共享之间)和第三个,人特有的信号. 动机主题研究对每个人有一个观察,因此不能测试第三个组成部分. 我们比较了每个臂与公布的集合系数,这个系数测试了第二个组件,即系统是否在集合中复制了真实的人文-context相互作用.

blocks.en: 5.2. A Naturalistic Check: Chameleon
blocks.zh: 5.2. 自然检查:变色龙

blocks.en: This check asks whether each system reproduces a known pattern in real people, in which most of what varies in their behavior is within each person, from one situation to the next, and little is between people. The target is the Chameleon dataset ( Harry et al., 2026 ) , with 1,667 Reddit users and three posts each in different subreddits. Each post is scored on twenty-six trait dimensions, including the five Big Five personality traits (extraversion, agreeableness, conscientiousness, neuroticism, and openness), which are the outcomes each simulation must reproduce. The other twenty-one dimensions, from values, self-determination, and risk-taking scales, describe the person in the persona. In the real data about 1% of the variation is between people, and almost all of it is within each person across situations (§ 2.2 ). This uses a bias-corrected ICC, which removes the noise that three posts per person add.
blocks.zh: 这个检查质问每个系统是否复制了真人中已知的模式,其中他们行为上的差异大多在每个人内部,从一种情况到另一种情况,人与人之间几乎没有. 目标是Chameleon数据集(Harry et al., 2026),有1,667个Reddit用户,以及不同子编辑中各3个帖子. 每个帖子的分数是26个特性,包括五个大五的个性特征(外向、可接受、自觉、神经和开放),这是每个模拟必须复制的结果。 其他21个维度,从价值、自决和冒险尺度,都描述了人体内的人。 在真实数据中,大约1%的差异发生在人与人之间,而且几乎所有的差异都发生在每个人的不同情况下(第2.2节)。 这使用了一种偏向修正的ICC,它消除了每人增加三个员额的噪音.

blocks.en: On the first component, fixed personas show the opposite of the real pattern (Table 1 ). The real between-person share is about 1% (mean ICC 0.013), and Arms A and B place it at 91% and 80%. Arm C is the closest to the real value on all five traits and on average (0.285), and it recovers extraversion almost exactly (0.023 against 0.019). On the other four traits it remains above the real value, by 24 to 65 times on agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness, and below it on neuroticism. On the third component, person-specific signal is near zero for every arm (mean correlation 0.026 for Arm A, 0.025 for Arm B, and 0.004 for Arm C), and only extraversion is significant for all three (Table 1 ). This is the pattern Proposition 2 predicts for fixed personas. Their small positive values are what the robustness corollary (§ 4.2 ) expects, since a persona built from scores of the user’s own posts, and subreddits that users chose for themselves, can carry a little information about that user’s specific responses. With about 4,570 comparisons per trait, the test can reliably detect a correlation of about 0.04 or more (80% power, Appendix C.1 ). It therefore rules out a correlation well above that size in every arm and cannot separate the arms below it, so whether the person-in-context design recovers person-specific signal remains open.
blocks.zh: 在第一个组件上,固定人物显示与真实模式相反(表1)。 人与人之间的实际份额约为1%(平均ICC 0.013),武器A和B将其定为91%和80%。 臂C在所有五个特征和平均值上最接近实际值(0.285),它几乎完全恢复了外向(0.023对0.019). 在另外四个特征上,它仍然高于实际价值,24到65倍于同意性、自觉性和开放性,低于神经病。 在第三个组件上,每个臂的人物特异性信号接近0(Arm A的平均值为0.026,Arm B的平均值为0.025,Arm C的平均值为0.004),所有三个臂都只有外向效应(表1). 这是2号提案对固定人物的预测 他们的微小正值是强性必然结果(§4.2)所期望的,因为从用户自己的几十个帖子上建立的人,以及用户自己选择的子编辑,可以携带一些关于该用户具体反应的信息. 通过对每个特征进行大约4,570个比较,测试可以可靠地检测出大约0.04个或以上的关联(80%的功率,附录C.1 ). 因此,它排除了每个臂的大小远高于这个尺寸的关联,无法将下臂分开,因此,内装人员设计是否恢复了特定人的信号仍然开放.

blocks.en: Table 1. Chameleon results by trait and arm. ICC is the bias-corrected between-person share, and bold marks the arm closest to the real value. Person-specific correlation is the correlation with the real residual Δ p , c \Delta_{p,c} , bold marks the highest value in a row, and an asterisk marks a 95% interval that excludes zero (Appendix Tables 4 and 5 ).
blocks.zh: 图表 1. 变色龙按特征和手臂产生结果。 ICC是人与人之间共享的偏差修正,粗体标记手臂最接近真实值. 人物特异性是和实际残存的 QQ p, c\Delta_{p,c} 的关联,粗体标记为一行中的最高值,星号标记为95%的间隔,不包括0(附录表4和表5).

blocks.en: 5.3. A Published Target: The Motivational-Themes Study
blocks.zh: 5.3. 公布的目标:动机-主题研究

blocks.en: The motivational-themes study ( Harry and others, 2026 ) asked which advertising themes make a clinical-trial recruitment ad effective for Black adults in the United States, measured by how appealing respondents found the ad and how willing they were to participate and to recommend the trial. It also measured each respondent’s trust in the healthcare system, because distrust of medical institutions is documented in this community ( Scharff et al., 2010 ; Armstrong et al., 2013 ) and could change how a theme lands. We use its published results as the target.
blocks.zh: 动机主题研究(Harry等人,2026年)询问哪些广告主题使得临床审判招募在美国对黑人成年人有效,衡量标准是:有吸引力的被调查者如何找到广告,以及他们是否愿意参与并建议审判. 也衡量了每个被调查者对医疗系统的信任,因为这个社区记录了对医疗机构的不信任(Scharff等人,2010年;Armstrong等人,2013年),并且可以改变主题如何落地。 我们把公布的结果作为目标。

blocks.en: 5.3.1. Setting and Reproduction Target
blocks.zh: 5.3.1. 设定和复制目标

blocks.en: The study surveyed 829 Black adults. Each saw one of four ad themes (contribution to science, community benefit, blood-pressure management, financial compensation), a between-subject design. They rated appeal, willingness to participate, and willingness to recommend on 5-point scales. The target has two parts. First, no theme has a significant main effect on any outcome ( p = .25 p=.25 to .93 .93 ). Second, theme and trust interact for the blood-pressure theme. All six blood-pressure by trust odds ratios are below 1 at both trust extremes relative to neutral, which means lower odds of a favorable rating. Significance alternates by outcome between the trust side and the distrust side. The target is this six-coefficient directional pattern, which is stricter than significance at both extremes (Appendix Table 10 lists the published design and values). For each arm we estimate the same six interactions and compare their signs with the published ones. The main analysis is a linear model in rating points with the contribution-to-science theme and neutral trust as baselines, and Appendix Table 11 repeats the comparison under seven analysis specifications.
blocks.zh: 该研究调查了829名黑人成年人. 每个主题都看到了四个广告主题中的一个(对科学的贡献,社区福利,血压管理,经济补偿),一个主题间设计. 他们对呼吁、参与意愿和在5点比额表上提出建议的意愿进行了评级。 目标有两个部分 首先,任何主题都不会对任何结果产生显著的主要影响(p=25 p=25 至.93.93 ). 第二,血压主题的主题与信任交互. 所有六种通过信任概率的血压比率在两种信任极端相对于中性均低于1,这意味着有利评级的概率较低. 在信任和不信任之间通过结果来替代意义。 目标是这种六合的定向模式,在两个极端都比意义更严格(附录表10列出了已公布的设计和数值). 对于每个臂部,我们估计同样的六种相互作用,并将它们的标志与公布的标志进行比较。 主要分析是以贡献对科学主题和中性信任作为基线的评级点的线性模型,附录表11重复了7个分析规格下的比较.

blocks.en: The theme main effect does not separate the families, but the interaction is informative, since it requires the same theme to evoke a different response depending on a person-level trait. A fixed persona can reproduce part of this pattern in aggregate, because the language model links a stated trait to the ad text on its own. It cannot represent an identity that changes with the theme. The aggregate interaction is therefore a coarse test of whether a system represents the shift, since it cannot show whether any single simulated person changed.
blocks.zh: 主题主要效果并不将家庭分开,但互动是信息化的,因为它需要同样的主题来引起不同的响应,这取决于个人层面的特点。 一个固定人物a可以综合复制这一模式的一部分,因为语言模型将一个已声明的特性与广告文本单独连接. 它不能代表一个随主题而改变的身份. 因此,集合相互作用是对一个系统是否代表转变的粗糙测试,因为它无法显示是否有单个模拟人改变.

blocks.en: 5.3.2. Materials and Cohort
blocks.zh: 5.3.2. 材料和配料

blocks.en: All three arms see the study’s advertisement text and outcome wording word for word. Arm C uses six identity states written from the literature (Appendix C.3 ). The Medical Skeptic state, on which the target interaction depends, is driven mainly by trust tier (activation probability 0.70 for distrust, 0.35 for neutral, 0.15 for trust), with capped demographic modifiers that cannot outvote trust. Appendix C.3 gives the calibration history.
blocks.zh: 所有三个机构都看到研究报告的广告文本和结果措辞。 Arm C使用文献中记载的六个身份状态(Appendix C.3 . 目标互动所依赖的医学悬疑状态主要是由信任层次(激活概率0.70用于不信任,0.35用于中性,0.15用于信任)驱动的,其限制的人口修饰剂不能超过信任. 附录C.3给出了校准历史.

blocks.en: Assignment is between-subject, as in the original study. We use 6,632 demographically resampled personas, one theme each, and all three arms run on identical cells. As § 5.1 explains, Claude Haiku 4.5’s training data end in February 2025, thirteen months before the study’s publication, which makes contamination unlikely.
blocks.zh: 任务在学科之间,如原始研究. 我们使用6,632个人口再现的人物,每个主题一个,三个手臂都运行在相同的细胞上. 正如第5.1节所解释的,Claude Haiku 4.5的培训数据于2025年2月,即研究出版前13个月结束,这使得污染不太可能发生。

blocks.en: 5.3.3. Results

The generative step responds to the active state. In the full run, 479 of 6,632 personas received, by chance, at least one response under an active Medical Skeptic state and one under their theme’s own state. The paired within-person difference is large and consistent ( − 1.76 -1.76 appeal, − 1.24 -1.24 participate, − 2.44 -2.44 recommend), with the same direction in 87 to 100% of personas (Appendix Figure 5 ). A forced, matched 30-per-condition check gives non-overlapping 95% intervals. Switching a persona’s active state reliably changes behavior in the expected direction.
blocks.zh: 基因步骤对活动状态有反应. 在6,632人中,479人偶然在活跃的医学怀疑状态下至少收到一份答复,还有一份是在他们自己的状态下收到的。 人与人之间的配对差异很大且一致(上诉 - 1.76 - 1.76, − 1.24 - 1.24 参与,− 2.44 - 2.44 建议),在87%至100%的人中方向相同(附录图5)。 强制的、匹配的每30个条件的检查可以使95%的间隔不重叠。 切换一个人的活跃状态可以可靠地改变预期方向的行为.

blocks.en: At n = 6,632 n=6{,}632 , Arm C reproduces the trust main effect but not the interaction. An initial n = 829 n=829 run, matching the original study, was ambiguous. Interaction effects need larger samples than main effects to detect, so the cohort grew to n = 6,632 n=6{,}632 , with roughly 500 to 630 personas per critical cell. At this size Arm C shows a large, precise trust main effect. Mean appeal rises from 2.41 (distrust) to 3.04 (neutral) to 3.42 (trust), tracking the activation rate of the Medical Skeptic state (0.78, 0.43, 0.22; cell means in Appendix Table 13 ). For the six blood-pressure by trust coefficients, we compare the direction of each simulated interaction with the published one (Appendix Table 11 , row 2). Arm C matches 2 of 6, and both matches are coefficients close to zero. Arm A matches 5 of 6. Arm B, which adds only a theme sentence to Arm A, matches 0 of 6. Two arms that differ by one sentence give opposite directions, so a fixed persona’s agreement with the published direction reflects incidental wording, so it is weak evidence that the persona represents the mechanism. Guessing would match 3 of 6 on average, so a count is a coarse test. The larger sample ruled out under-sampling as the explanation, and did not produce the interaction.
blocks.zh: 在n = 6,632 n = 6{,}632,Arm C 复制了信任的主要效果,但不复制相互作用. 最初n=829n=829运行,与原研究相匹配,模棱两可. 相互作用效应需要比主要效应更大的样本来检测,因此组群增长到n=6,632n=6{,}632,每个临界细胞约有500至630人. 在这个尺寸的Arm C显示一个大,精确的信托主效应. 平均上诉率从2.41(不信任)上升到3.04(中立)上升到3.42(信任),跟踪医疗怀疑状态的激活率(0.78,0.43,0.22;单元格在附录表13中表示)。 对于以信任系数表示的6个血压,我们将每个模拟相互作用的方向与公布的相互作用的方向进行比较(附录表11,第2行)。 臂C匹配6中的2个,两个匹配都是接近0的系数. 武装A匹配5的6。 Arm B只为Arm A添加一个主题句,匹配0的6. 两种不同句子的手臂给出了相反的方向,因此固定人物a与公布方向的约定反映了偶然的措辞,因此,作为人物代表机理的微弱证据. 估计平均3比6,所以计数是粗糙的测试. 较大的样本排除了作为解释的样本不足,没有产生相互作用.

blocks.en: The diagnosis concerns structure. The Medical Skeptic state’s activation floor is the same for all four themes by design. It can shift the level of activation by theme, but not the slope of the response to trust. Only a theme-dependent slope can produce an interaction. Without one, the model yields a general main effect, and this limit holds at any sample size. Arm C also rates the blood-pressure theme lower than the contribution-to-science theme at every trust level (mean appeal 2.78 against 3.16 at neutral trust; Appendix Table 13 ), a theme main effect the real study did not find. For Arm A the limit comes from the design (Propositions 1 and 2). For Arm C it is a gap in this particular π I \pi_{I} , and the natural-experiment check shows the mechanism itself is not barred from closing it (Appendix Table 3 summarizes both datasets).
blocks.zh: 诊断涉及结构。 医疗怀疑状态的激活层在设计上对所有四个主题都是一样的. 它可以根据主题改变激活水平,但不能将响应的坡度转移到信任. 只有依赖主题的坡度才能产生相互作用. 没有一种,模型产生一般的主要效果,这个限制在任何样本大小上都存在. Arm C还评分每个信任级别血压主题低于贡献对科学主题(中性信任中平均呼吁2.78对3.16;附录表13),这是真实研究没有发现的主题主要效果. 对于Arm A,限制来自设计(建议1和2)。 对于Arm C来说,这是这个特别的__I\pi_{I}的一个漏洞,自然实验检查显示机制本身并不妨碍关闭(附录表3总结了两个数据集)。

blocks.en: Figure 2. The real published effect dips at both trust extremes (all six coefficients negative), while the domain-general mechanism shows no dip at either extreme (all six simulated coefficients are − 0.01 -0.01 or higher). Published coefficients are log-odds and simulated ones are rating points, so the figure compares shape and sign only. A single-axis activation mechanism cannot resolve this mismatch by calibration alone.
blocks.zh: 图 2. 实际公布的效果在两个信任极端(所有6个系数均为负数)均没有显示任何极端(所有6个模拟系数为−0.01-0.01或更高)的偏差。 已公布的系数是log-odd,模拟的系数是评分点,因此该数字只比较形状和签名. 单轴激活机制无法单靠校准解决这种不匹配.

blocks.en: A theory-motivated refinement does not close the gap. Amplifying the trust-linked state’s activation spread for the blood-pressure theme (fixed before evaluation, Appendix C.3 ) does not raise the match count under the contribution-to-science baseline (1 of 6, against 2 for the domain-general mechanism). With a pooled-theme baseline it reaches 3 of 6, and Arm A falls to 2 or 3, so the order of these arms depends on the baseline. We make no claim that the refinement improves on the domain-general mechanism, and because the amplified theme was chosen knowing where the real effect lies, it is also a weaker test. The more useful result is the shape of the real effect. All six published coefficients are negative. High-trust and high-distrust respondents both rate the blood-pressure theme lower than neutral-trust respondents. A mechanism that moves along one trust axis cannot produce a dip at both extremes (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 以理论为动力的完善并不能弥合差距。 为血压主题扩大信任状态的激活范围(在评价前确定,附录C.3)并不能提高贡献与科学基线下的匹配计数(6比2(域一般机制为2)). 由于集合主题基线达到6分之3,武装A降至2或3,因此这些武器的顺序取决于基线。 我们没有声称完善完善改进了域-一般机制,由于拓宽主题的选择知道真正的效果在哪里,它也是一个较弱的测试. 更有用的结果是真实效果的形状. 所有六个公布的系数均为负数. 高信任和高信任的答复者都认为血压主题低于中信任的答复者。 沿着一个信任轴移动的机制不能在两个极端都产生倾斜(图2)。

blocks.en: 5.4. Interpretation: What Both Datasets Show
blocks.zh: 5.4. 口译: 两个数据集都显示什么

blocks.en: Neither dataset tests whether the person-in-context family is capable of context-dependent behavior, since the natural-experiment and forced-contrast checks in § 5.3.3 show that it is. They test whether this implementation of π I \pi_{I} closes the gap in practice, which Proposition 2 does not address.
blocks.zh: 无论是数据集都无法检验契约人家族是否有能力进行上下文依赖的行为,因为第5.3.3节中的自然实验和强制冲突检查表明这是事实。 它们检验的是,执行`I\i\pi\i}是否弥补了实践中的空白,而提议2并未涉及。

blocks.en: The failure can be diagnosed. The real effect dips at both trust extremes, a shape that no single-axis mechanism can represent (Figure 2 ), which is why the theme-amplified refinement produces no gain in Appendix Table 11 . Chameleon adds a complementary view. Its real within-person signal is faint, so it tests whether the implementation’s gain in aggregate variance carries over to person-specific signal, and so far it does not (§ 5.2 ). Appendix Table 3 sets the two datasets side by side. Together they show what the implementation already does, which is to produce behavior that follows the active state, and where work remains, in the choice of state and its link to person-specific signal.
blocks.zh: 衰竭可确诊. 真实效果在两个信任极点都发生倾斜,这个形状是没有任何单轴机制能够代表的(图2),这就是为何在附录表11中对主题进行验证的完善不会产生任何收益. 变色龙增加了一个补充视图. 其真正的人内信号是微弱的,因此它测试执行的累计差异收益是否延续到针对个人的信号上,到目前为止它没有(§5.2). 附录表3将两个数据集并列. 它们共同显示执行已经做了哪些工作,即产生遵循活动状态的行为,以及仍然在工作的地方,在选择状态及其与具体人物信号的联系方面。

blocks.en: 6. Discussion
blocks.zh: 6个 讨论情况

blocks.en: 6.1. What the empirical tests show, and what they do not
blocks.zh: 6.1 (英语). 经验测试显示什么 和它们没有

blocks.en: The proof and the implementation are separate questions. Propositions 1 and 2 (§ 4 ) concern the design, and the experiments concern one implementation of the alternative. The difficulty in those tests concentrates in π I \pi_{I} , the step that selects the identity state, while the generative step, f f , performs well (§ 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 证明和执行是不同的问题。 提案1和2(§4)涉及设计,实验涉及替代品的一次实施。 这些测试的困难集中在选择身份状态的一步,而基因步骤f f 表现良好(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: Some of what we observe comes from the language model as well as from the design. Ratings follow a stated trait almost mechanically, and Arm A’s appeal ratings sit close to 2, 3, and 4 for distrust, neutral, and trust in every theme (Appendix C.4 ). One added sentence reversed five of the six interaction coefficients (Arm B). And the model responds strongly and in the expected direction when its active identity state is switched (§ 5.3.3 ), so the weak point is choosing the state. Acting it out works. The theory does not supply these facts about language models as simulators, and they should be rechecked with other models.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到的一些东西来自语言模型以及设计. 评分几乎是机械化的,Arm A的上诉评分接近2、3和4,因为不信任、中立和信任每个主题(附录C.4)。 增加的一句话推翻了六个相互作用系数中的五个(Arm B)。 而模型在主动身份状态切换(§5.3.3)时反应强烈并朝着预期方向进行,因此弱点是选择状态. 演出来是可行的。 该理论不提供这些关于语言模型作为模拟器的事实,应当与其他模型重新检查.

blocks.en: 6.2. What this changes for evaluation practice
blocks.zh: 6.2. 评价做法的这一变化

blocks.en: Persona adherence is the right check for the tasks that fixed-persona and memory-evolving systems were built for, namely covering varied profiles ( Li et al., 2026b ) , predicting individual attitudes ( Park et al., 2024 ) , and simulating sandbox dynamics ( Park et al., 2023 ) . It is the wrong check when such systems are proposed for behavioral simulation, because § 3.3 shows that a design can satisfy persona adherence and still be unable to produce the person-context interaction that behavioral simulation needs. Any claim of behavioral simulation should report the criterion in § 4 directly instead of inferring it from adherence or demographic accuracy.
blocks.zh: Persona 坚持是检查为固定人称和内存演进系统构建的任务的正确办法,即涵盖各种剖面(Li等人,2026b),预测个人态度(Park等人,2024),模拟沙盒动态(Park等人,2023年)。 在提出这样的系统用于行为模拟时,这是错误的检查,因为§3.3显示,一个设计能够满足人格的坚持性,仍然无法产生行为模拟需要的人物-文字交互. 对行为模拟的任何主张都应直接报告第4款中的标准,而不是从遵守率或人口准确性推断出来。

blocks.en: The motivational-themes study adds guidance for the one family that can simulate behavior in principle. Because the failure sits in π I \pi_{I} , auditing the generative step alone checks necessary behavior but not sufficient behavior, so evaluations should also audit π I \pi_{I} against real population data (Appendix C.3 ) and should not treat a literature-grounded specification as self-validating.
blocks.zh: 动机主题研究为可以原则上模拟行为的一个家族增加了指导. 因为失败发生在 π I\pi_{I}, 仅审计基因步骤 检查必要的行为, 但不足够的行为, 所以评价也应该 审计 π I\pi_{I} 相对于真实的人口数据(Appendix C.3),

blocks.en: 6.3. What this changes for identity representation
blocks.zh: 6.3. 身份代表的这一变化

blocks.en: The fixed-persona design misrepresents groups whose behavior depends on context, and richer personas do not remove the problem. The distrust example from the introduction applies here, since a fixed persona stores distrust as a static attribute or leaves it out, and neither represents a state that the situation activates, as with distrust of medical institutions in the motivational-themes study ( Scharff et al., 2010 ; Armstrong et al., 2013 ) . § 5.3.3 shows the risk is concrete, because our own person-in-context design, built to represent trust as context-dependent, produces a version of the same flattening. The risk therefore appears whenever a mechanism that selects identity states under-represents how a trait depends on context.
blocks.zh: 固定人物设计会歪曲其行为取决于上下文的团体,而富人并不能消除问题. 引言中的不信任例子在此适用,因为固定人物存储不信任作为静态属性,或将其排除在外,也不代表这种情况会像在动机主题研究中对医疗机构的不信任一样(Scharff等人,2010年;Armstrong等人,2013年). § 5.3.3 显示风险是具体的,因为我们自己为代表信任而构建的隐形人物设计,产生了一个版本的同一平坦. 因此,每当选择身份的机制说明特征如何取决于上下文时,风险就会出现。

blocks.en: This also moves an accountability question without removing it. A fixed persona’s content can be traced to a stated source, such as demographic conditioning or a profile instrument. A person-in-context system also needs someone to specify ℐ p \mathcal{I}_{p} itself (the set of identity states available to each person, § 3.2 ), meaning which identity states exist, what activates them, and whether a behavior counts as state-typical or person-specific. That choice is an interpretation. Our own mechanism needed four locked revisions (documented versions, each fixed in writing before it was run and each prompted by a failed internal check) before it passed those checks, and the first three versions, though literature-grounded, failed them. The question shifts from what the persona says to who decides what a person’s possible identity states are.
blocks.zh: 这也提出了问责制问题,但没有予以删除。 固定人a 的内容可以追溯到一个说明的来源,例如人口条件或概况工具。 一个隐形人系统也需要有人指定 I \ mathcal{I}_{p} 本身( 每个人可用的一组身份状态, §3.2) , 意思是存在哪些身份状态, 哪些激活它们, 以及一个行为是否算为状态典型或个人特定 。 这种选择是一种解释。 我们自己的机制在通过这些检查之前需要4个锁定的修改(有文件记录的版本,每个版本在运行之前都固定在文字上,每个版本都是由失败的内部检查引起的),而前3个版本虽然以文献为基础,但却失败了. 问题从人所说的话转移到谁决定一个人可能的身份。

blocks.en: 6.4. Limitations

Data. The 6,632 simulated personas in the motivational-themes study match the published share of each demographic group, such as age or income, but not how those characteristics combine in real respondents. The Chameleon test uses the real users, with three posts each (§ 5.2 ). Method. The identity states are written by hand, so the results concern this implementation and say nothing about learned mechanisms (§ 6.5 ). In Chameleon, Claude Haiku 4.5 also scores how well each subreddit matches each identity state (Appendix C ), in a separate call from the one that generates behavior, so shared biases may carry through, a concern raised for LLM-as-judge setups ( Li et al., 2026a ) , and we did not test for this. In the motivational-themes study the cue scores were set by the authors, and the Medical Skeptic score was revised after a pilot (Appendix C.3 ). The three identity-state panels were isolated agent sessions of Claude Sonnet 5.5, one model family with no human raters. Their agreement rules out one unlucky sample, but not a bias that all three share. Scope. The framework models cross-sectional response only, and the between-subject motivational-themes study limits that test to the aggregate interaction. The proof does not depend on any of these.
blocks.zh: 数据。 动机-主题研究中的6,632个模拟人物与每个人口组别的公布比例(如年龄或收入)相匹配,但与这些特征在真实的答卷人中的结合方式不同。 变色龙测试使用真正的用户,每个有3个帖子(§5.2). 方法。 方法吗? 身份状态是手工写成的,因此结果与这一执行有关,对学到的机制只字不提(第6.5节)。 在Chameleon, Claude Haiku 4.5 也评分了每个子编辑与每个身份状态的匹配程度(附录C), 在动机主题研究中,线索分数由作者设定,医疗怀疑分数在飞行员后修改(附录C.3 . 三个身份状态面板是克劳德·索内5.5的孤立代理会议,一个没有人评分的模范家庭. 他们的协议排除了一个不吉利的样本, 但不是所有三个共享的偏见。 范围。 框架模型仅是跨部门反应,主体激励-主题之间研究将测试限制在总相互作用. 证据并不取决于其中任何一项。

blocks.en: 6.5. Forward

Three directions follow. First, § 5.3.3 motivates activation mechanisms that do not move along a single trust axis, since the real effect dips at both trust extremes. One outcome can arise from different states, for example institutional distrust at one extreme and a different skepticism at the other. Second, it is open whether the baseline-plus-activated-states structure in § 3.2 is general or specific to Chameleon. A related test is whether Arm C does best on the trait whose context cues are clearest, which could explain why it recovers extraversion (§ 5.2 ). We have not tested this. Third, because the difficulty sits in π I \pi_{I} , it could be learned against held-out real data instead of set by hand ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , for example with an input-driven switching state-space model in which context drives transitions between identity states and a language model writes the behavior from the current state. Testing it needs longitudinal data that our datasets lack.
blocks.zh: 三个方向跟着。 第一,第5.3.3节激发了不沿着单一信任轴移动的激活机制,因为实际效果在两个信任极端都发生了下降。 一个结果可能来自不同的国家,例如一个极端的体制不信任和另一个极端的不同怀疑。 第二,第3.2节中的基线加激活状态结构是一般结构还是变色龙特有的结构是开放的。 一个相关的测试是Arm C在上下文提示最清晰的特征上是否表现最好,这可以解释它为什么能恢复外向(第5.2节). 我们没有测试这一点。 第三,由于难度位于 π I\pi_{I} 中, 它可以从被搁置的真实数据中学习, 而不是用手设定( Wu et al., 2026) , 例如用一个输入驱动的状态- 空间切换模型, 其中上下文驱动身份状态之间的过渡, 语言模型从当前状态写出行为 。 测试它需要我们数据集缺乏的纵向数据。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Data and human subjects. We collected no new human-subjects data, and both datasets are already published. Chameleon is a public dataset of pseudonymous trait scores computed from public Reddit posts. It keeps the original post identifiers, so a record could in principle be linked to a public post. We made no attempt to identify, link, or contact any user, and we report results only in aggregate. The motivational-themes study contributes its published coefficients, sample demographics, and survey wording ( Harry and others, 2026 ) . We used the advertisement text only as a fixed input to language models, and did not use it to recruit or contact anyone. An institutional review board determined through its self-determination process that the project is not human-subjects research.
blocks.zh: 数据与人类学科. 我们没有收集新的人类主题数据,两个数据集已经公布。 Chameleon是一个由公共 Reddit 帖子计算的假名特征分数的公共数据集。 它保留了原始的帖子识别符,因此记录原则上可以与一个公开的帖子联系起来. 我们没有试图识别、链接或联系任何用户,我们只报告总体结果。 动机主题研究贡献了其公布的系数,抽样人口统计,以及调查措辞(Harry等人,2026年). 我们只把广告文本用作语言模型的固定输入,没有用来招募或联系任何人. 机构审查委员会通过其自决进程确定该项目不是人的研究对象。

blocks.en: Population construction and the risk of encoding stereotypes. The identity-state specification in § 5.3 was built for a population, Black adults evaluating clinical-trial recruitment materials, for whom misrepresentation has real stakes, given the documented history of harm and eroded trust around clinical research ( Scharff et al., 2010 ; Alsan and Wanamaker, 2018 ) . Three steps address this. The state content and demographic modifiers came from the independent health-behavior and clinical-recruitment literature, without using the target study’s results (Appendix C.3 ). Three isolated, blind sessions of Claude Sonnet 5.5 checked the specification without access to the target study’s findings (three sessions of one model, which are not independent raters; see § 6.4 ). And the paper’s central claim is that institutional distrust in this population is context-activated , so assigning a static “distrusts the healthcare system” trait to a demographic group is the essentializing move the paper argues against. This does not remove the risk of misuse, because a published state specification could be separated from its context-activation framing.
blocks.zh: 人口建设与刻板印象编码风险. §5.3中的身份状态规格是针对一个人口,即评价临床审判招募材料的黑人成年人制定的,由于有文献记载的伤害历史和围绕临床研究的信任受到侵蚀,对这些人而言,虚报确有利害关系(Scharff等人,2010年;Alsan和Wanamaker,2018年)。 三个步骤解决这个问题。 国家内容和人口修饰来自独立的保健行为和临床招聘文献,没有使用目标研究结果(附录C.3)。 Claude Sonnet 5.5的三个孤立的盲目会议检查了规格,没有查阅目标研究的结论(一个模型的三个会议,不是独立的评分;见6.4节)。 本文的核心主张是,对这种人群的体制不信任是环境引发的,因此,将静态的“不信任医疗系统”特征赋予一个人口群体是论文所反对的至关重要的举动。 这并不消除滥用的风险,因为公布的状态规格可以与其上下文活化框架分开。

blocks.en: Deployment risk. This work does not support replacing engagement with underrepresented populations by simulation, and our results are evidence against doing so. A reader could conclude that a validated person-in-context system could substitute for focus groups, surveys, or community engagement, especially for populations that are costly to recruit. That is where substitution would do the most harm. Our mechanism was literature-grounded, checked by blind model sessions, and run on a sample eight times the size of the original study, and it still did not reproduce the published interaction. This weakens the case for treating current synthetic output as a substitute for the represented population. These methods suit stress-testing evaluation infrastructure, but decisions about real populations need independent validation.

blocks.en: B.5. Assumption defensibility across the fixed-persona family
blocks.zh: B.5. 整个固定人家庭的假设可辨别性

blocks.en: Each assumption is more plausible for some designs than for others. The Key Assumption is strongest for closed-schema personas built from fixed demographic or categorical fields, which have no channel for person-specific cross-context deviation. It is weaker for rich, open-ended personas such as interview transcripts, which could incidentally encode traits correlated with person-specific activation. There Corollary 1 or Corollary 2 carries the argument in place of the exact-zero result, and the degradation is graceful (small ϵ 1 \epsilon_{1} , small bound). The Context Exogeneity Assumption is strongest for experimentally assigned contexts, such as the between-subject theme randomization in § 5.3 , and weaker for observationally sampled ones, such as the subreddit choices in § 5.2 , where a person’s tendencies could influence which contexts they appear in. Corollary 2 carries the argument there, and § 4.3 states this as a scope condition.

blocks.en: The target population is 1,667 Reddit users (Chameleon ( Harry et al., 2026 ) ), each with three posts across distinct subreddits, scored on five Big Five personality constructs plus twenty-one auxiliary trait dimensions using SEANCE, a psycholinguistic text-analysis tool that scores language for psychological content. The real signal is faint. Bias-corrected ICC(1) is approximately 0.01 to 0.02 across all five constructs, so 98 to 101% of real variance is within-person, with the upper end above 100% because Neuroticism’s bias-corrected estimate is slightly negative ( − 0.007 -0.007 , Table 4 ), a known property of this estimator when the true value is near zero. Real person-context interaction variance is small in absolute terms, at 0.072 for extraversion, 0.049 for agreeableness, 0.067 for conscientiousness, 0.022 for neuroticism, and 0.043 for openness.

Arm B adds the subreddit name. Arm C adds the active identity state (Appendix C.2 ). The full-scale run covers all 1,667 users with two or three replicates per cell, in the hybrid reasoning-and-rating format of Appendix C.5 .

blocks.en: ICC. Real ICC clusters in a narrow, near-zero band (0.01 to 0.02). Arms A and B invert this near-completely, with between-person shares of 83 to 95% for Arm A (mean 0.909) and 60 to 89% for Arm B (mean 0.799) against a real mean of 0.013, as § 3.3 predicts. Arm C’s aggregate ICC (mean 0.285) sits substantially closer to the real value, but the improvement is not uniform (Table 4 ). Extraversion is recovered almost exactly, while agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness overshoot by roughly 24 to 65-fold, and neuroticism overshoots more strongly in the negative direction. A person-in-context design that had recovered the real structure would show similarly small ICC on every construct, whereas Arm C’s values spread widely across constructs.

blocks.en: Detectability. Each person-specific correlation rests on about 4,570 person-context comparisons per construct, and its interval comes from a bootstrap that resamples whole users (1,000 resamples). The standard errors implied by those intervals are 0.012 to 0.016 (mean 0.0145), so an observed correlation must be about 0.033 to 0.045 (mean 0.041) to be detected with 80% power. A simulation that gives a synthetic system a known correlation with the real person-specific residuals confirms this, with detection rates of 78% at 0.04 and 98% at 0.05 (60 repetitions each). Arm A’s and Arm B’s mean correlations (0.026 and 0.025) lie below that size, and Arm C’s mean (0.004) lies far below it. The test therefore rules out an observed correlation well above 0.04 in every arm and cannot separate the arms below about 0.04. The real residual also contains post-level noise, so even a perfect simulator would score well below 1 on this measure, and a near-zero value does not show that person-specific signal is absent.
blocks.zh: 可探测性。 每个人物的特异性都基于每个构造大约4,570个人物与文字的比较,其间隔来自一个靴子圈,可以重新复制整个用户(1,000个复制品). 这些间隔所隐含的标准误差为0.012至0.016(平均值0.0145),因此观测到的关联性必须约为0.033至0.045(平均值0.041),才能以80%的功率检测到. 一种让一个合成系统与真实人特异性的残基有已知关联的模拟证实了这一点,在0.04时的检测率为78%,在0.05时的检测率为98%(每次60次重复). Arm A和Arm B的平均值(0.026和0.025)低于这一大小,Arm C的平均值(0.004)远低于这一大小。 因此,这项试验排除了每个臂上观察到的远高于0.04的关联,无法将臂下约0.04分辨出来. 真正的残留也包含后级噪声,因此即使一个完美的模拟器在这个测量中也会得分远低于1,一个近零的值并不显示不存在针对特定人物的信号.

blocks.en: Because this specification could not rule out prior exposure to the target study’s findings, an independent circularity check was run before locking the taxonomy. Three isolated LLM sessions were each given only a neutral task description (build a literature-grounded identity state taxonomy for this population and context) with no access to this specification or the target study’s findings, and instructed to disregard the target study if it surfaced in their own search. One session had zero exposure to the study across its entire search. Their independently built taxonomies were compared against the draft specification for convergence, driving two merges, one addition (an identity state that emerged unprompted in all three), and giving Medical Skeptic, the identity state the paper’s reproduction target depends on, the strongest independent convergence of all six.

blocks.en:
Arm C’s mechanism required four locked revisions before passing
internal-validity checks, each triggered by a specific diagnostic failure rather than
outcome-directed tuning. The first implementation, a literature-cited competition among all six
identity states, was not self-calibrating, since individually well-grounded modifier magnitudes let the intended
trait be outvoted by unrelated, more prevalent correlates (a college-education correlate common to
76% of the pilot personas overwhelmed the trust-distrust modifier defining Medical Skeptic). The
mechanism that finally passed instead special-cases Medical Skeptic as a direct function of its
own defining trait.

blocks.en: In Chameleon, the context cue-matching score a r , c a_{r,c} is produced by Claude Haiku 4.5, the same language model that generates persona behavior, in a separate call. This is an LLM-as-judge design in the sense of Zheng et al. (2023) and Gu et al. (2026) . In the motivational-themes study the cue scores are fixed integers from 0 to 2 for each ad theme (Table 9 ), set in the code from the specification’s activation cues. The Medical Skeptic score was raised from 1 to 2 after the first pilot showed that the state never activated, and the state was later replaced by a direct trust gate. The literature-grounding and circularity-check panels described above and in Appendices C.2 and C.3 were isolated agent sessions of Claude Sonnet 5.5 run through Claude Code, with no access to each other’s output. They were not human raters. § 6.4 discusses the resulting judge-and-subject concern.

blocks.zh: C.4. 动机-主题研究:分析规格和强性

blocks.en: The real study reports six blood-pressure by trust coefficients, one for each of three outcomes (appeal, willingness to participate, willingness to recommend) at each trust extreme, relative to neutral trust and to the contribution-to-science theme. For each simulated arm we estimate the same six interactions and record whether the sign matches the published sign. All six published coefficients are negative, so direction-uncorrelated guessing matches 3 of 6 on average. Table 12 lists the six simulated coefficients for each arm under the main-text specification.
blocks.zh: 真正的研究报告了6种通过信任系数造成的血压,一种针对三种结果(呼吁、参与意愿、推荐意愿)的每一种极端,相对于中立信任和科学贡献主题。 对于每个模拟臂,我们估计同样的六种相互作用,并记录标志是否与公布的标志相符. 所有六个公布的系数都是负数,所以方向不相关猜测平均匹配6的3. 表12列出了主文本规格下每个臂的六个模拟系数.

blocks.en: Before computing any arm’s results, we fixed one primary specification to mirror the original study, an ordered logit (a cumulative-link model) for each outcome, with theme and trust interacted, the contribution-to-science theme and neutral trust as baselines, and the demographic adjusters of the published model. The original model has a random intercept for repeated measures. We replace it with standard errors clustered by persona. The main text reports a linear version of the same model, which gives contrasts in rating points, for the following reason. Simulated ratings follow the trust tier almost deterministically. In Arm A’s appeal ratings the fitted trust effects reach + 6.4 +6.4 and − 11.9 -11.9 log-odds, which is close to separation, and the ordered-logit interaction coefficients are then unstable in size. A shift of − 0.12 -0.12 rating points appears as − 1.7 -1.7 log-odds. Sign counts are the same under both models for the baseline we use (Table 11 ), so this choice does not change the direction results. With 6,632 personas almost every coefficient is statistically significant, so we compare direction and size and give significance only for reference.
blocks.zh: 在计算任何臂部结果之前,我们设定了一个主要规格来反映最初的研究,一个针对每个结果的有序登录(累积链接模型),主题和信任相互作用,贡献与科学主题和中立信任作为基线,以及公布模型的人口调整器. 原型有随机截击,用于重复测量. 我们用由人组成的标准错误来取代它。 主文报告同一模型的线性版本,在分数上给出对比,原因如下. 模拟评级几乎按确定性遵循信任等级。 在Arm A的吸引力评级中,装配的信托效应达到+6.4+6.4和−11.9-11.9对数,接近分离,订购-日志相互作用系数在大小上不稳定。 −0.12-0.12分的差值为−1.7-1.7对数。 符号计数在我们使用的基线的两个模型下都是相同的(表11),因此这个选择不会改变方向结果. 几乎每个系数的6,632人都具有统计意义,因此我们比较方向和大小,只给予参考意义。

blocks.en: C.5. Elicitation-Format Validation
blocks.zh: C.5. 说明-格式验证

blocks.en: Both empirical demonstrations use a hybrid {reasoning, rating} structured-output format, in which the model gives a short reasoning and then a rating. We chose it in a pilot on eight persona-context pairs from the motivational-themes study (20 samples each, Claude Haiku 4.5, temperature 0.7). The pairs were drawn from an earlier 20-pair pilot, five where a bare structured rating gave identical answers across all 20 samples and three where it did not. The pilot compared three formats, namely a bare structured rating, free text ending in a rating, and the hybrid. Table 14 gives the mean sampling variance of the appeal rating.
blocks.zh: 两种经验演示都使用混合的{合理,评级}结构化的输出格式,其中模型给出了简短的推理,然后给出了评级. 我们在一个实验中从动机主题研究中选取了8对人文文字配对(每个样本20个,Claude Haiku4.5,温度0.7). 这两对都是从一个早期的20帕飞行员中抽取的,其中5对完全结构化的评分在所有20个样本中给出了相同的答案,3对没有给出相同的答案。 该试点比较了三种格式,即赤裸结构的评级,在评级中结束的自由文本,以及混合版. 表14列出上诉评级的平均抽样差异。

blocks.en: Table 14. Mean sampling variance of the appeal rating over eight persona-context pairs, by elicitation format, with 95% bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples). Each format has 160 responses.
blocks.zh: 表14. 按诱导格式划分的8个人文字对吸引力等级的平均抽样差异,95%的靴子间隔(2 000个复标)。 每种格式都有160份答复。

blocks.en: The bare format gave the lowest variance, and the hybrid recovered about 37% of the gap between the bare format and free text. With eight pairs the intervals overlap, so this is a pilot-scale result. Low variance in the model’s ratings would hide interaction effects whatever the activation mechanism does, so a format that does not suppress variance was a precondition for a fair test. We chose the hybrid over free text because its schema-validated output guarantees parseable responses at the scale of the main runs (about 25,000 responses for the motivational-themes study). Free text parsed at 100% in this 160-response test, but one small run with one prompt template does not guarantee that at scale.
blocks.zh: 赤色格式给出了最小的差异,混合体恢复了赤色格式和自由文本之间约37%的空隙. 间隔有8对重叠,因此这是一个试点规模的结果。 无论激活机制如何,模型评级的低差异会隐藏相互作用效应,因此不抑制差异的格式是公平测试的先决条件。 我们选择了混合文本而不是自由文本,因为其具有计划验证的输出保证了在主运行规模上可解析的反应(动机-主题研究大约25,000个响应). 自由文本在这个160响应测试中解析为100%,但是一个带有一个即时模板的小型运行并不能在规模上保证这一点.

blocks.en: All arms share the opening of the system prompt: “You are simulating the survey response of a specific person for a research study on synthetic population simulation. Respond only as this person would. Do not break character or comment on the task.” It is followed by “Persona:” and the demographic line from Table 15 . • Arm A adds the trust sentence for the person’s tier. The three sentences are: “Based on your life experience, you generally distrust medical institutions and clinical research.” (distrust), “You have a fairly neutral, wait-and-see attitude toward medical institutions and clinical research.” (neutral), and “Based on your life experience, you generally trust medical institutions and clinical research.” (trust). • Arm B adds the same trust sentence plus one sentence naming the ad theme: “This ad emphasizes contributing to scientific research.” (research), “This ad emphasizes improving the well-being of Black communities.” (community), “This ad emphasizes personal health benefit, specifically improving your own blood pressure.” (blood pressure), or “This ad emphasizes free groceries or cash compensation.” (perks). • Arm C adds no trust sentence. It adds “Right now, this person’s salient concern is:” followed by the norm of the selected identity state. The six states are Community & Scientific Contribution, Health Focused, Medical Skeptic, Prudential Consumer, Privacy & Surveillance Wary, and Faith-Centered Providence, and their full wording is in Appendix C.3 . The user turn is identical in all arms and consists of the ad followed by the outcome question. The ad has the form “[study name]; [theme headline]; A 12-week research study investigating the potential impact of fresh groceries on lowering blood pressure in Black adults. [contact line removed for review]”. The four headlines are “Join our clinical trial to advance scientific research!”, “Join our clinical trial to study a way to improve the well-being of Black communities!”, “Join our clinical trial to study a dietary approach to improve your blood pressure!”, and “Join our clinical trial to receive either free delivered fresh groceries or cash!” The outcome question reads: “Assume [the medical center] is a research hospital near where you live. blocks.en: The persona line is built from the user’s trait scores. We rank 21 trait dimensions (values, motivation, and risk attitudes) by how far they are from average, keep the five largest, and write one sentence for each in the high or low form. The five Big Five constructs are the outcome and are never in the persona. An example for a constructed user, whose top five traits include novelty-seeking and comfort with social risk, is: “Persona: This person seeks novelty, excitement, and new experiences. This person is comfortable with social risks, like disagreeing publicly. This person isn’t especially attached to tradition or custom. This person doesn’t feel especially connected to other people right now. This person sticks closely to ethical rules.”

blocks.en: For Arm C, a separate call scores each subreddit once against the five activation cues. The system prompt reads “You are scoring how well a Reddit community’s typical content matches a set of behavioral/content cues, for a research study on context-activated identity. Score based on the community’s general content and tone, not any specific post.” The user turn reads “Community: r/[subreddit]. For each set of cues below, score 0, 1, or 2 how well r/[subreddit]’s typical content matches it (0 = no match, 1 = some/background match, 2 = strong/central match)”, followed by the five cue descriptions, and the model returns a short reasoning and one score per state. The cue descriptions are, in the order of Table 7 : • Expansive Engaged. Content involving active social engagement, competitive or achievement framing, novelty-seeking, or discussion of risk-taking across financial, recreational, or social domains, such as competitive gaming, entrepreneurship and investing, adventure or physical-risk activities, active dating, and high-energy outgoing social interaction. • Amotivated Disinhibited. Content reflecting disengagement, low investment, or venting without goal-orientation, combined with casual mentions of rule-bending, safety-cutting-corners, or gambling, such as low-effort complaining, confession-style rule-breaking, casual gambling or lottery discussion, and anonymous low-investment participation. • High-Intensity Reactive. Content involving high emotional intensity combined with high personal investment or striving, but not framed around risk-taking, such as high-stakes personal-crisis discussion, competitive achievement under pressure, and emotionally charged advice-seeking where the poster is highly engaged and anxious. • Quiet Withdrawn. Content that is low-stakes, passive, or solitary, such as casual browsing or lurker-friendly communities, simple hobby or leisure content without competitive or social-striving framing, and low posting or interaction demands. • Conventional Risk-Tolerant. Content that frames risk-taking within a conventional or practical, duty-oriented lens, such as personal finance or insurance framed around family responsibility, traditional-values-adjacent communities where practical rule-bending is normalized, and health or safety trade-offs made for practical or family reasons.
